pair_decision.evidence: P1 shows coherent, strong opposite-signed jumps in N (-3.52 to +0.00) and E (+1.38 to +3.23) with U also reversing sign (-12.56 to -10.67), consistent with a return after onset. P2 and P3 lack such coherence: P2’s E and U show same-sign changes (no reversal), and P3’s N/E/U all shift in same direction without clear sign reversal. Only P1 satisfies the return criterion of joint, sign-reversed change in reliable components.
